He asks to be bound well 'lest I tremble and the slaughter be rendered UNFIT' - the technical law of what invalidates an offering spoken by the intended offering itself, inside the scene. His age is recorded with variance across seats, thirty-seven against twenty-six, carried rather than resolved. [folded shape: priced law]

Chiya the Great from where it is known that ritual slaughter requires a DETACHED, movable instrument - and the answer is this verse: 'Abraham EXTENDED HIS HAND and took the knife.' The taking-up IS the requirement. A procedural rule still binding, derived from a narrative motion. [folded shape: priced law]
